text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Huh... Eh, eh, huh? Huh? What... why?! W-What are you saying? What? Eh? Me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ……
え、
え、
え？　
あれ？　
なんっ……
なんで！？
なに、
なに言ってんの？　
は？　
え？　
私っ？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! What is this, I don't understand! I really don't get it, scary! There are tons of other candidates out there, why on earth would he pick me? I cannot believe this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇー！　
何ソレわかんない！　
わかんな過ぎ、
恐っ！
候補者売るほどいる中で、
わざわざ私の択とかある？　
信じないが？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Huh? But wait a minute? This is basically... a confession from him...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
だって待って？　
コレって実質、
彼からの告は──

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: ...No, no, no! That's not it! No way! That's quite a leap! What kind of messed-up train of thought is that, me...? This is bad, really bad. He's going to realize I am hopeless with guys. Gotta build up my resistance. Don't underestimate me. Your Senpai is not that easy, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──いやいやいや違う、
まさかね！
　それは飛躍！
発想きもすぎだって、
私……
まずいまずい、
非モテばれちゃう。
免疫あげてこ。
なめんな。
そんなに先輩ちょろくないぞ？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Um... By the way, umm... Why did you choose me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あの……
えと……
ちなみになんだけど、
その…………
なんで私選んだ？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: "For some reason"? I see, haa... for some reason...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜか？
そうなんだ、
はー、
なぜか──

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, wait! No! It's fine! Really... all okay! I'm totally grateful! Actually, that is so you, and... it really got me right in the feels... I think? Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あ、や、
違っ！
いいです！
　いい、
いい！
　全然ありがたい！
むしろ君っぽいし、
ちゃんと刺さった……
かな？
　って、
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Right? Yeah, exactly, it's like... I don't even know how to call this... I got hit with such a rare piece of content that my entire sense of self is short-circuiting. It happens every now and then lately, but it's basically like my hometown accent suddenly coming out, so just ignore it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねー？
　そうなの、
もうなんか、
なんだろ……
レア過ぎる供給が貫通してきて、
自我テンパってるよね。
最近まれによくあるんだけど、
実家の訛りみたいなやつだから流して。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Eh, why?! Don't apologize for that. Because then I'd be an idiot for getting all happy over it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
なんで！
そこは謝んないでよ。
じゃあ
言われて喜んじゃった私、
ばかみたいじゃん……

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I understand, thanks. I'd love to... accept those feelings of yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
分かった、
ありがと。
私それ──
その気持ち、
受け取りたいです。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. Correction... Ahem. I shall accept them. If I am the one you have chosen, then surely there is no greater honor for a Senpai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああいや、
訂正……
受け取ってやろう。
君に選ばれたのならばな、
先輩冥利に尽きるというものだ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Then let me say this, too. Let the two of us weave the strength to overcome this crisis. We can do it... I will trust in the answer you have chosen, my reliable comrade.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば、
こちらからも言おう。
この危機を乗り越える力を、
ぼくら二人で紡ごう。
我々ならそれが出来る──
頼れる同志が選んだ答えを、
信じよう。
